mapper.update: update batch.file_dispatch_record set dispatch_status = #{dispatchStatus}, dispatch_attempt = dispatch_attempt + 1, receipt_status = #{receiptStatus}, error_code = null, error_message = null, dispatched_at = null, ack_at = null, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and file_id = #{fileId} and channel_code = #{channelCode} and dispatch_status in ('FAILED', 'COMPENSATED') and coalesce(error_code, '') <> #{unknownOutcomeCode}

with authorized_source_task as ( select source_task.id, source_task.tenant_id, source_pipeline.id as source_pipeline_instance_id from batch.pipeline_instance dispatch_pipeline join batch.job_instance dispatch_job on dispatch_job.id = dispatch_pipeline.related_job_instance_id and dispatch_job.tenant_id = dispatch_pipeline.tenant_id join batch.trigger_request child_request on child_request.id = dispatch_job.trigger_request_id and child_request.tenant_id = dispatch_job.tenant_id join batch.workflow_run parent_run on parent_run.id = child_request.parent_workflow_run_id and parent_run.tenant_id = child_request.tenant_id join batch.trigger_request resolution_request on resolution_request.id = parent_run.trigger_request_id and resolution_request.tenant_id = parent_run.tenant_id join batch.job_task source_task on source_task.tenant_id = resolution_request.tenant_id and source_task.id::text = resolution_request.launch_payload #>> '{params,_externalOutcomeResolutionTaskId}' and source_task.external_outcome_resolution_version::text = resolution_request.launch_payload #>> '{params,_externalOutcomeResolutionVersion}' and source_task.external_outcome_resolution_trigger_request_id = resolution_request.id join batch.job_instance source_job on source_job.tenant_id = source_task.tenant_id and source_job.id = source_task.job_instance_id and source_job.job_code = dispatch_job.job_code join batch.pipeline_instance source_pipeline on source_pipeline.tenant_id = source_job.tenant_id and source_pipeline.related_job_instance_id = source_job.id where dispatch_pipeline.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispatch_pipeline.id = #{pipelineInstanceId} and dispatch_job.id = #{jobInstanceId} and source_task.task_status = 'FAILED' and source_task.error_code = #{unknownOutcomeCode} and source_task.external_outcome_resolution_consumed_at is null and coalesce( nullif(source_task.task_payload ->> 'fileId', ''), nullif(source_task.task_payload ->> 'bundleSourceFileId', '') ) = cast(#{fileId,jdbcType=BIGINT} as text) and coalesce( nullif(source_task.task_payload ->> 'channelCode', ''), nullif(source_task.task_payload ->> 'bundleTargetRef', '') ) = #{channelCode} for update of source_task ), eligible_dispatch_record as ( select dispatch_record.id from batch.file_dispatch_record dispatch_record join authorized_source_task source_task on source_task.tenant_id = dispatch_record.tenant_id and source_task.source_pipeline_instance_id = dispatch_record.pipeline_instance_id where dispatch_record.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispatch_record.file_id = #{fileId} and dispatch_record.channel_code = #{channelCode} and dispatch_record.dispatch_status = 'FAILED' and dispatch_record.error_code = #{unknownOutcomeCode} for update of dispatch_record ), started_dispatch_record as ( update batch.file_dispatch_record dispatch_record set pipeline_instance_id = #{pipelineInstanceId}, dispatch_status = #{dispatchStatus}, dispatch_attempt = dispatch_attempt + 1, receipt_status = #{receiptStatus}, error_code = null, error_message = null, dispatched_at = null, ack_at = null, updated_at = current_timestamp from authorized_source_task, eligible_dispatch_record where dispatch_record.id = eligible_dispatch_record.id returning dispatch_record.id ) update batch.job_task source_task set external_outcome_resolution_consumed_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp from authorized_source_task, started_dispatch_record where source_task.tenant_id = authorized_source_task.tenant_id and source_task.id = authorized_source_task.id and source_task.external_outcome_resolution_consumed_at is null
